name: Eggs Poached in Spicy Marinara (Eggs in Purgatory) with Garlic Toast
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; medium dice.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Place half in a small bowl and set aside for the garlic toast.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, remaining garlic, and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes.
When the pepper is soft, increase heat to medium-high and add marinara to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roughly chop.

Once the sauce is simmering, add basil and stir to combine. Using a stirring spoon, make a well for each egg in the marinara; crack an egg into each well. Cover and cook until the egg whites are firm but yolks are still soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the eggs are cooking, add oil and spices to the bowl with the remaining garlic. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
Split rolls in half and arrange on a large baking sheet pan; drizzle with the garlic oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until rolls are toasted, 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
Divide eggs and sauce between plates or bowls and sprinkle with Parmesan. Serve with garlic toast on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
